jobs.title: VP, Finance, Corporate Segments and Total Company Expenses
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Vice President, Finance, Corporate Functions and Total Company Expenses is a senior Finance leader responsible for providing strategic financial leadership across the organization's global Corporate Functions, enterprise-wide expense management and significant enterprise initiatives.

The VP serves as a trusted advisor to senior Corporate Function and Finance executives, bringing an independent, enterprise-wide perspective to financial performance, resource allocation, expense management and investment decisions.

Operating across businesses, functions and geographies, the role brings together financial insights to provide senior leadership with a Total Company view of expenses, productivity, investments, risks and opportunities,
while ensuring major enterprise initiatives are appropriately prioritized and deliver measurable business value.

Key Role Accountabilities

Corporate Segment

Serve as the senior Finance partner to Corporate Function leaders, providing strategic advice, constructive challenge and decision support.
Lead planning, forecasting, reporting and performance management across Corporate Functions.
Translate Corporate Function strategies into clear financial implications, resource requirements and investment choices.
Provide forward-looking insights on financial performance, emerging risks, opportunities and structural cost drivers.
Challenge assumptions and recommend actions to improve financial and operational outcomes.
Maintain view of Corporate Function costs and the underlying services and capabilities driving those costs.
Lead continued enhancement of Corporate cost allocation methodologies.
Evolve transparency to Business Groups regarding Corporate services and allocated expenses including balancing transparency and precision with the need for allocation methodologies that are practical, understandable and decision useful.
Partner with Business Group Finance leaders to understand cost drivers, forecast allocations and identify optimization opportunities.
Partner with Capital, Investment teams and tax for Corporate segment results, forecasts and plan

Lead the consolidation, analysis and executive reporting of Total Company expenses.

Identify underlying expense trends, emerging pressures and opportunities for management action.
Provide an Enterprise-wide view of expense performance across businesses, functions and geographies.
Develop forward-looking insights regarding the organization's expense trajectory and key financial sensitivities.
Partner with Business Group and Corporate Finance teams to establish consistent expense definitions, methodologies and management reporting.
Provide senior executives with a clear narrative explaining what is driving expense performance, and where sustainable opportunities exist.
Lead Finance oversight and insights for enterprise expense-management and productivity programs.
Identify structural opportunities to improve the organization's cost base and operating leverage.
Establish frameworks and metrics for measuring productivity and sustainable expense reduction.
Ensure savings commitments have clearly defined baselines, owners, timing and measurable financial outcomes.
Track execution against enterprise expense commitments and escalate risks or gaps requiring management intervention.
Bring external perspectives and financial-services benchmarks into enterprise expense-management discussions.

Lead the Finance Centre of Excellence for Enterprise Key Initiative governance.

Establish consistent standards for business cases, financial evaluation and approval of significant enterprise investments.
Provide independent Finance challenge of investment assumptions, costs, benefits, execution risks and ongoing operating impacts.
Support executive prioritization of competing investments based on strategic importance, affordability, capacity, risk and expected value.
Establish appropriate financial governance throughout the investment lifecycle, from initial business case through implementation and benefits realization.
Continuously enhance investment-governance frameworks and executive reporting.
As the team and company grow, the responsibilities of this position may expand to adapt to changing organizational goals.
undefined

Key Skills & Attributes

Proven experience at building and developing a strong team
Excellent interpersonal, organizational and team building skills.
Excellent oral, written and, presentation skills, with strong attention to detail.
Proven ability to influence the performance of others to deliver results.
Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to work in a team environment and across multiple sites and multiple business units.
Strong business acumen with a strong understanding of IFRS 17 and IFRS 9
Ability to apply advanced financial concepts and capabilities across business activities.
Experience and knowledge in collaborating with Senior Business and Corporate Leaders.
Proven experience leading in a matrix model with the ability to foster effective working relationships and negotiate solutions.
Effective communication, negotiation, and conflict management skills.
Effective change management, through impact and influence skills.

Education And Experience

Accounting Designation with 10+ years of experience in the financial management field in a senior leadership role or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in FP&A, corporate finance, expense management, investment governance and/or business partnering.
Experience operating within a large, complex, matrixed organization.
Experience supporting senior executives and influencing decisions across business groups and geographies
Demonstrated experience leading teams through change.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

195,000/195 000 - 270,000/270 000

General Management

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Enersul L.P.

As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.

General Overview

The Director of Finance will provide strategic financial leadership to enable the company to grow responsibly, in a profitable and sustainable manner. The Director will ensure the integrity of accounting information and accurate Marmon Standard Practice Instruction compliant financial statements through strong internal controls and accounting knowledge, reporting to the Vice President of Finance & Controller. This position will be a driver of data-based decision making through financial analysis, collaborating cross-functionally, disseminating financial information and knowledge.

The Director will lead the accounting department with four direct reports, and will work closely with the Enersul Management Team. The position is an in office role based out of the Enersul head office in Calgary, AB.

Overall Responsibilities

The list below highlights the essential job responsibilities but is not exhaustive.

Partner with business leaders to shape strategy and drive key business decisions, leveraging financial and operational insights to identify opportunities, manage risk, improve profitability, and support sustainable growth.
Proactive management of month-end close, financial reporting, working capital, and account reconciliations, ensuring accurate, timely, and GAAP-compliant financial statements.
Lead budget and forecast preparation and reporting according to schedule, aligned with Marmon requirements.
Manage and prepare parent company reporting requirements through OneStream.
Ensure compliance with Marmon’s Standard Practice Instructions, Sarbanes Oxley internal controls, and Foreign Corrupt Practice Act. Ensure that financial and IT SOX documentation is maintained in a current manner. Coordinates and supports internal/external audits.
Coordinate and support annual and quarterly tax compliance, including the gathering, review, and reconciliation of information for income tax, sales/use tax, payroll tax, and other statutory filings, working closely with corporate tax and external advisors.
Properly disseminate appropriate financial data within Enersul and Marmon to aid corporate decision-making and planning.
Improve and implement new processes within the finance team to ensure continued improvement and innovation.
Manage the capital investment process (Authorization for Expenditure), working cross-functionally to assess payback and IRR, through to the accounting for capital assets.
Develop and coach employees to achieve maximum potential. Sustain a culture of innovation, high energy, and performance in line with Enersul’s mission, vision and values.
Contribute to other business priorities and projects as required.

Qualifications, Skills, Competencies

Knowledge of finance, accounting, budgeting and cost control principles including US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.
ERP experience, Epicor or similar.
Knowledge of automated financial and accounting reporting systems and experience streamlining reporting for more efficient and effective results.
Operational business mindset, with proven leadership experience.
Self-motivated, organized, with strong attention to detail.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
CPA required.

Learn more about Enersul www.enersul.com

Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.

Job Description:

The VP Finance, Global Technology oversees key financial and strategic investment items for Global Technology. This role will report to the SVP & CFO, Global Technology, Finance Strategy and Operations

The role is responsible for overseeing Enterprise-wide view of technology financial performance, investment priorities and value realization. The VP partners closely with Technology executives, Business Group Finance leaders, Procurement, and other corporate functions to ensure technology resources and investments are aligned to enterprise strategy and deliver sustainable business value.

The role operates across geographies, businesses and functions and requires the ability to influence decisions in a highly matrixed global financial-services environment.

Key Role Accountabilities

Act as the senior Finance partner and trusted advisor to Global Technology leadership.
Lead the financial planning, forecasting, reporting and performance-management processes for Global Technology.
Develop clear insights on technology cost, investment trends, risks and opportunities for senior management.
Bring an enterprise perspective to decisions, balancing Technology priorities with the needs of individual businesses and geographies.
Establish transparency into the Enterprise technology cost base and its key economic drivers.
Provide insight into run versus change spend, workforce, vendors, infrastructure, software and major transformation investments.
Partner with Technology leadership on productivity, modernization and transformation.
Translate Technology strategies into clear financial implications, resource requirements and investment choices.
Drive disciplined management of financial commitments and emerging risks.
Provide financial leadership across the technology investment portfolio.
Establish financial frameworks for evaluating and prioritizing competing investments including AI.
Challenge investment assumptions, expected benefits, implementation costs and ongoing operating implications.
Lead continued evolution of Enterprise technology cost allocation transparency and appropriate financial discipline.
Ensure business leaders understand the services and technology capabilities driving their costs.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with the Business Group finance teams
Build, attract and develop a strong and diverse team
As the team and company grow, the responsibilities of this position may expand to adapt to changing organizational goals.

Key Skills & Attributes

Proven experience at building and developing a strong team
Excellent interpersonal, organizational and team building skills.
Excellent oral, written and, presentation skills, with strong attention to detail.
Proven ability to influence the performance of others to deliver results.
Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to collaborate and drive execution across functions and geographies.
Ability to apply advanced financial concepts and capabilities across business activities.
Proven experience leading in a matrix model with the ability to foster effective working relationships and negotiate solutions.
Effective communication, negotiation, and conflict management skills.
Effective change management, through impact and influence skills.

Education And Experience

Accounting Designation with 10+ years of experience in the financial management field in a senior leadership role or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Proven experience leading in a matrix model across multiple businesses, functions and geographies
Experience with FP&A technology cost management, investment governance, allocation methodologies and/or large transformation portfolios.
Experience operating within a large, complex, matrixed organization.
Experience supporting senior executives and influencing decisions across business groups and geographies
Demonstrated experience leading teams through change.
